10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker selected from the group consisting of zirconium, aluminum, iron, titanium, and chromium.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, and wherein said nanoparticle exhibits a predominance of negative surface charges.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said multivalent cation crosslinker of claim 1; and c) a fluid.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said fluid is brine or seawater, and wherein the composition exhibits delayed gelation upon aging.
